notes: Not enough evidence to confirm what 'zai-glm-5' (no version suffix) refers to on Mistral's platform. I fetched Mistral's models overview page's raw HTML directly and it lists 'zai-glm-5-2' and 'zai-glm-5-3' as Z.ai GLM models Mistral hosts (both active, third-party, 1M-token context), but no bare 'zai-glm-5' appears in either the active or deprecated tables, the changelog has no GLM entries at all, and /models/zai-glm-5 404s. The naming pattern (zai-glm-<version>) suggests this was Mistral's listing for Z.ai's original 'GLM-5' model, but Z.ai's own current docs give GLM-5 a 200K-token context window and 128K max output, versus this target's catalog facts of 1,048,576 (1M) max input tokens - a 5x mismatch, unlike zai-glm-5-2 and zai-glm-5-3 whose 1M figures I could verify exactly against both Mistral's and Z.ai's own pages. Given the id is undocumented anywhere on Mistral's current site and the number conflict, I could not confidently confirm this is Z.ai's GLM-5 as currently specified, or whether it is stale/retired. Returning insufficient_sources rather than guess.
